title: Verb Structures: separable verbs, 次 / 下 / 趟, verb + 给, 多 / 少 + verb, verb + 到 + time
description: Verbs that split (见面, 帮忙), counting actions, giving to someone, doing more / less, and until when.

points.title: Separable verbs: 见面, 帮忙 …
points.summary: Some verbs are verb + object inside: 见面, 帮忙, 睡觉, 游泳. They can't take another object directly; aspect markers and counts go **inside**.
points.body:
- 我跟他**见面**了 — not ~~我见面他~~.
- 我**帮**了他一个**忙**.
- 我们见过两次**面**.

points.title: Verb measure words: 次, 下, 趟
points.summary: 次 = times (occurrences). 一下 = briefly. 趟 = a trip there and back.
points.body:
- 我去过三**次**北京.
- 你等一**下**.
- 我明天要去一**趟**银行.
examples: I've been to Beijing three times.

points.title: Verb + 给 + person
points.summary: 送, 借, 交, 卖 … + 给 + person = give / lend / hand in / sell to someone.
points.body:
- 这本书是朋友**送给**我的.
- 请把作业**交给**老师.
examples: Please hand your homework in to the teacher.

points.title: 多 / 少 + verb: do more / less
points.summary: 多 + verb = do more of it; 少 + verb = do less of it (advice).
points.body:
- 你感冒了，应该**多**喝水.
- 你最好**少**吃甜的.

points.title: Verb + 到 + time: until
points.summary: Verb + 到 + time / event = do it until ….
examples: He works until late every day.

notes: 跟 + person comes before the verb.
见面 already has an object (面) — use 跟 + person.

questions.explanation: Split it: **帮 + person + 一个忙**.
notes: 帮忙 can't take a person as a second object.
帮忙 can't take a person as a second object.
个 isn't used to count meetings.
questions.translation: We've only met twice — we don't know each other well.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān}（　）{北京|Běijīng}，{每|měi}{次|cì}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{开心|kāixīn}。
questions.translation: I've been to Beijing three times and loved it every time.
Wait a moment, I'll be right there.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{明天|míngtiān}{要|yào}{去|qù}{一|yí}（　）{银行|yínháng}，{取|qǔ}{点儿|diǎnr}{钱|qián}。
notes: 遍 = from start to finish (reading, listening).
questions.translation: I need to make a trip to the bank tomorrow to get some money.
A friend gave me this book.

notes: The thing can't go between 给 and the person.
questions.translation: Please hand your homework in to the teacher.

notes: 少喝水 is bad advice for a cold.
questions.translation: You've got a cold — drink more water and rest more.

questions.prompt: {为了|wèile}{健康|jiànkāng}，{你|nǐ}{最好|zuìhǎo}（　）{吃|chī}{甜|tián}{的|de}{东西|dōngxi}。
notes: 多吃甜的 isn't healthy advice.
questions.translation: For your health, you'd better eat fewer sweet things.

questions.prompt: {明天|míngtiān}{考试|kǎoshì}，{我|wǒ}{昨天|zuótiān}{学习|xuéxí}（　）{十二|shí'èr}{点|diǎn}。
notes: 学习在十二点 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: There's an exam tomorrow — I studied until midnight yesterday.
He works until late every day.
